name: Skita
verdict: Self-owned French sportswear maker (Skita Sportwear, equipementier sportif). Nothing found.
note: Rated during the Arouca research (issue #386): FC Arouca's kit maker from 2026-27 (partner placement). Footy Headlines calls Skita a 'domestic manufacturer' of Arouca's, but the brand is French - skita.fr.
